data.body: [P2] Journal service retries through `record_service_attempt`. `record_attempt` assigns `launchedAtMs` regardless of the `source` diagnostic. A retry first discovered during release or retirement therefore triggers adjudication's `INCOMPLETE: frozen observations do not cover all client-journaled launches`, even with valid retirement evidence. Use `record_service_attempt` with the original native request identity so these entries receive `discoveredAtMs`, and add a regression covering discovery after observations freeze.
